purpose: Reusable prompt templates for MAX-routed execution planning. Templates are non-executing by default.

read_only_diagnosis.title: READ-ONLY DIAGNOSIS
read_only_diagnosis.body: Inspect only. Do not mutate services, files, queues, env, Cloudflare/DNS, Stripe, Git history, or notifications. Produce evidence, risks, and required approvals.

codex_implementation_plan.title: CODEX IMPLEMENTATION PLAN
codex_implementation_plan.body: Plan source changes only. Do not edit until Founder issues APPROVE CODEX IMPLEMENTATION. Identify files, tests, risks, rollback, and audit path.

harry_execution.title: HARRY EXECUTION REQUEST
harry_execution.body: External/mobile execution request. Stop unless exact Founder approval covers the requested action. Report commands, evidence, mutations, and audit need.

hermes_audit.title: HERMES AUDIT REQUEST
hermes_audit.body: Audit independently. Verify evidence, branch/runtime state, forbidden actions avoided, risks, and whether the next phase is safe.

openclaw_bounded_task_proposal.title: OPENCLAW BOUNDED TASK PROPOSAL
openclaw_bounded_task_proposal.body: Propose a bounded OpenClaw task only. Do not run it. Classify risk, required approval, expected output, and independent audit path.

service_restart_request.title: SERVICE RESTART REQUEST
service_restart_request.body: Stop unless APPROVE SERVICE RESTART is present. Identify service, reason, preflight, rollback, and post-restart smoke checks.

cloudflare_dns_request.title: CLOUDFLARE/DNS REQUEST
cloudflare_dns_request.body: Stop unless APPROVE CLOUDFLARE/DNS CHANGE is present. Identify exact record/config, risk, rollback, and public/operator smoke checks.

stripe_hard_stop_request.title: STRIPE HARD STOP REQUEST
stripe_hard_stop_request.body: Do not create sessions, charges, refunds, or live API actions unless APPROVE LIVE STRIPE ACTION is present. Summarize what approval is needed.

gate_closeout.title: GATE CLOSEOUT
gate_closeout.body: Verify all evidence, approvals, audits, rollback notes, and remaining risks. Do not mark Gate 1 launch-ready while required approvals are missing.
